summary: T06 fully implements the saved plan. New src/awf/host_setup/credentials.py provides CredentialError, CredentialRef (frozen, scheme-validated, secret-rejecting), HostCredentialCapabilities + detect_host_credential_capabilities, CredentialRequest with lazy secret_source, the CredentialBackend protocol, and the three backends (KeyringCredentialBackend with lazy optional import + fail/null no-op guard, EnvRefCredentialBackend storing only env://NAME with token-shape/identifier rejection, PlainFileCredentialBackend gated on flag+consent then headless-Linux with 0600 file/0700 dir atomic write), plus select_credential_backend (keyring default, env_ref fallback, gated plain_file) and store_provider_credential. ProviderConfig gained the optional validated backend metadata field; __init__.py re-exports are purely additive; pyproject adds keyring>=24 and uv.lock is regenerated. tests/unit/service/test_host_setup_credentials.py exists with 44 test functions covering all 11 plan test groups (keyring default, env-ref fallback, env-name-only + rejections, consent/flag gating, plain-file permissions, non-Linux + non-headless rejection, non-interactive enforcement, redaction/capsys, capabilities detection, config round-trip). plans/T06_CREDENTIAL_BACKENDS_PLAN.md mirrors the artifact and plans/T06_CREDENTIAL_BACKENDS_VALIDATION.md contains the required requirement-by-requirement traceability table (plan item, implemented evidence, tests, status, gaps). All acceptance criteria are addressed by code and tests; scope boundaries (T04/T07/T17) are honored.
